The conversion rate uses 'converted' column which is defined as 1 if order completed checkout. However note that 'converted' may be 1 for some refunded orders? But they filtered to completed only, so fine. No missing data in converted. So no unacknowledged problems.

5. FALSE PREMISE: The premises are all true per data. No false premise. So fine.

Thus answer is sound. Verdict accept, no issues.
